title: verdict.v1
description: The `verdict.json` of a run directory: every window with its impact against its budget, the in-dialog impact with the windows it may belong to, the impact outside every window, and the integrity of the measurement. `hakit verdict <run-dir>` recomputes it from the run directory alone. ADR-0049.

status.description: `invalid` when an integrity finding exists (the run measured nothing trustworthy); else `fail` when any impact is a finding; else `pass`.

streams.description: Per stream: calls placed, calls never placed, records read, successes.

cps.description: The offered rate; with `steps`, the rate of the first step.

calls.description: Calls the generator says it placed (its own counter); null when the generator keeps none.

not_placed.description: Calls the generator refused to place (loadgen `rejected`): no record, no impact.

generator_failures.description: Calls the generator says it failed without a record (loadgen's own counter); absent when the generator keeps none.

stalls.description: Every generator stall of the stream (ADR-0049 §3.12): its start and length.

source.description: `starts`: a gap in the call starts; `watchdog`: the generator's own watchdog fired.

spoiled.description: The measurements the stall spoiled, listed in its `generator_stall` integrity finding.

event.description: The event id: `<seq>-<incident>`, the names joined by `+` for a combined event; `m<seq>-<incident>` for a manual event, `d<seq>-<name>` for a detected one.

budget.description: The budget by name; empty for a detected event with no `defaults` entry, whose window allows nothing.

status.description: `ok`, or `incident_failed` when an executable or probe failed and the window closed at the incident's maximum.

phases.description: Every phase reached, in order; `step` is the incident it belongs to.

facts.description: The JSON objects the incident executables printed, by incident, then by executable (`inject`, `heal`, `probe`).

recovery.description: Per stream that has a baseline: seconds from `healed` until it was back; null when it never was before the window closed.

impacts.description: The budgetable classes charged to this window.

findings.description: The number of impacts above their allowance in this window.

in_dialog.description: Every impact of the classes that take no budget, each a finding, with the windows whose inject fell inside the call's lifetime before the failure. One with no candidate window is listed in `unattributed` instead.

unattributed.description: Impact outside every window, by class and key. Every entry is a finding.

integrity.description: Why the measurement itself is in doubt.

kind.description: `record_gap`: a stream's records, calls not placed and generator failures differ from its generator's offered-call counter. `incident_failed`: an executable or probe failed or timed out. `stream_died`: a generator exited before its stream was due to stop. `series_stale`: a series the run reads stopped updating. `generator_failure`: a record names a `generator` failure, or the generator counted a call it failed without a record. `leftover_calls`: the system under test held calls before the run started. `window_overlap`: a window opened while another was open. `generator_stall`: the generator stalled across measurements, which leave the impacts (ADR-0049 §3.12). `class_failed`: a product class's count failed or printed no JSON array of impacts.

class.description: A built-in impact class or one a product added on the search path.

retry_after.description: The key's Retry-After: true for finals that carried one, false for an entry that matches only finals without one; absent, the key does not tell them apart.

count.description: Calls, or events for a class counted in events; for `recovery`, the seconds of the slowest stream.

seconds.description: The count in seconds of the stream's offered rate, when the impact has a stream.

allowed.description: The allowance the budget gives this key, in the unit of `count`.

call_ids.description: The Call-IDs of the calls counted, up to 50.
